vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setMaxTxAmount() that controls the maximum transfer amount for non-owner addresses. By setting this to 0, the owner can effectively block all user transfers while still being able to transfer themselves (since owner is excluded from the maxTxAmount check). This is a classic owner privilege abuse vulnerability.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the current owner and call setMaxTxAmount(0) to set the maximum transaction amount to zero, which will prevent all regular user transfers.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address by calling owner() on the target contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setMaxTxAmount(0) on the target contract. 4. Verify that _maxTxAmount is now 0.
